description:
Make a new sound effect with AI from a text prompt, free. Waits for it (usually about 10 seconds) and returns the best takes, each with a url (WAV) and a preview_url (MP3) that need no header, a file_name and a ready curl command: run it to save the file (curl -L -o <file_name> "<url>"). Links work for 30 days, so save what you keep.
Describe the sound plainly and specifically: "magic sparkle chime", "retro 8-bit coin pickup", "fast cinematic whoosh transition". Best for sound effects and short ambiences up to 10 seconds; not for music with structure or speech.
One job at a time per account, 250 a week. Takes are AI-generated (ai_content "ai"); tell the person. They aren't exclusive to the person: soundza may add takes to its library. Search the catalog first when an existing sound would do, and for music beds or anything over 10 seconds.

prompt.description: What the sound is, in plain words. Up to 200 characters.

takes.description: How many takes to return, best first: 1 to 3. Default 1.

name: generate_sound
title: Generate a sound
